m.d: You use especially to say that something is special, or somehow different from others.
m.e: Nobody was old, but Paulo was especially young.

m.d: A way to get away from something.
m.e: I'm afraid we have no escape.

m.d: If you escape something (or someone) you get away from it.
m.e: Can we escape the storm?

m.d: Someone's estate is everything they own, or everything they leave when they die.
m.e: Because he had no family, he left his estate to the church.

m.d: An estate is a large area of land with a large house on it.
m.e: On the weekend, we went fishing at her country estate.

m.d: A group of people (often with guns) who protect a famous person; a guard.
Someone's date; a person who goes with you in a social gathering.
m.e: I was her escort for the evening.

m.d: An escort is a sex worker who makes appointments with their clients and does not work in a brothel.
To guard and protect someone or something.
m.e: The police escorted the President.

m.d: To escort is to go with somebody.
If an institution, system, etc. is established, it has existed for some time and is probably well known.
m.e: The established church leaders often do no wish to see changes that might reduce their power.

m.d: If you establish something, you start it with the idea that it will last for a long time.
m.e: A good doctor will not only care for each of the patients but will also be able to establish a good relationship with them.

m.d: If something is essential, it is impossible to succeed without it.
m.e: Oxygen is essential for life on earth.

m.d: If something is essential, it is very important.
m.e: Cooked rice, is the essential element of the Chinese meal prepared south of the Yangtze River.

m.d: The essential part, idea, or feature is the most basic one.
m.e: The essential nature of skiing is sliding on two skis, but the sport is much more than that.

m.d: Esther is a female given name.
If something is essentially true, it is true in the most basic case.
m.e: He is essentially a good person.

m.d: If something is essentially true, it is mostly true.
m.e: The two products are essentially the same.

m.d: An essence is the most basic and important quality of something.
m.e: She seems the very essence of kindness.

m.d: The establishment of a country, an organization or a building is its creation, or coming to be.
m.e: The establishment of the United States of America took place in 1776.

m.d: Establishment is the state of being established.
m.e: 1987 was the fifth year of the company's establishment.

m.d: Something that is established. This can be a government, an organization, business or force.
m.e: Pedro's is a fine establishment that serves Spanish food.

m.d: An estimate is a judgement of a size, value, amount, cost, etc., which is based on incomplete information.
m.e: British Telecom will give you an estimate of the cost before doing any work.

m.d: If you estimate the number, size, value, amount, cost, etc. of something, you guess based on incomplete information.
m.e: It's difficult to estimate how long it will take to get to London because we don't know how bad the traffic will be.

m.d: Writing that looks at an issue or subject.
m.e: Each student had to write an essay on his favorite author.

m.d: To try.
To move forth, as into battle.
Espresso is a concentrated coffee beverage that is brewed by forcing hot water under high pressure through finely ground coffee.
A drink made using espresso may be called an espresso.
Espionage is a act of getting information about an organization or country that is meant to be secret or confidential.
A good opinion of someone or a view of high importance and respect for them.
m.e: He was an author who was held in high esteem.

m.d: to view someone or something as important, and respectable.
m.e: Esteemed by all, Sharon was a good leader.

m.d: An estranged person is a formerly close friend or relative who became a stranger.
If you escalate something, you increase its intensity.
m.e: Violence escalated during the election.

m.d: An escrow is a written document that is kept by a neutral third party and will only take effect when the conditions of the contract have been met.
If you escrow something, you place it in an escrow.
If you estrange someone, you cause them to be no longer on friendly terms with you.
